strings.jp: 抵抗しないでください!
strings.en: Please don't resist!

strings.jp: 負けられません!
strings.en: I cannot lose!

strings.jp: 貴方も鍛練が足りないようね
strings.en:
Seems you need more
training as well.

strings.jp: 姉さん、腰が入ってないわよ
strings.en:
Sister, there's no
weight behind that!

strings.jp: ごめんね…
strings.en: I'm sorry...

strings.jp: 敵将を捕らえました!
strings.en:
I have captured the
enemy general!

strings.jp:
ククク…
さっきの勢いはどうした?
strings.en:
Heh heh heh...
Where'd that fire go?

strings.jp: まだまだじゃな…王女よ
strings.en:
Thou hast far to go...
Princess.

strings.jp: 天刑と心得よ!
strings.en:
Know this as
Heaven's judgment!

strings.jp: 残念でしたー!
strings.en: Too baaad!

strings.jp:
剣に振り回されてるようじゃ
まだまだだぜ!
strings.en:
Lettin' the sword
swing ya? Still green!

strings.jp: スジはいいんだがのぉ
strings.en:
Ya got the makings,
I'll grant ya...

strings.jp:
金ピカ野郎め。本気で
ワシに勝てると思ったか?
strings.en:
Gilded twit! Ya think
ya could beat me?

strings.jp:
どう?
力の差がわかったでしょ?
strings.en:
Well? See how
outmatched you are?

strings.jp: グリフォン使いが甘いよ!
strings.en:
Ya ride that griffin
like an amateur!

strings.jp: 分かったら、とっとと消えな
strings.en:
Got it? Then beat
it already.

strings.jp: 私の相手じゃないわね…
strings.en:
You're no match for
me, dear...

strings.jp:
得体の知れぬ者に
負ける訳にはいかんな
strings.en:
I cannot lose to
some unknown thing.

strings.jp: フン、小うるさい女だ!
strings.en:
Hmph, what a noisy
woman!

strings.jp: か、神はわしの味方じゃ!
strings.en:
G-God is on my
side, ya hear!

strings.jp: あたしの腕が上だったようね
strings.en:
Seems I'm the better
fighter, darling.

strings.jp: いい男だけど、残念ね
strings.en:
Such a fine man...
what a shame.

strings.jp: ウンディーネ、ゲット♪
strings.en: One Undine... yoink~!

strings.jp: クケーケケケッ!
strings.en: Kukeeekekekeh!

strings.jp: グォォォォォー!!!
strings.en: Grooooooooh!!!

strings.jp: グォォォォォッ!
strings.en: Grooooogh!

strings.jp: 貴様には失望したぞ…
strings.en: You disappoint me...

strings.jp: あたくし、諦めませんのよ?
strings.en:
I don't give up,
you know, dear?

strings.jp:
良く頑張った方だと
思いますよ。フフフ…
strings.en:
You did rather well,
I'd say. Heh heh heh...
